name: LA-3A
notes: Probed 2026-11-23. Peak Reduction and Gain are 0-10 knobs on a different (solid-state) circuit, so they don't join the LA-2A family; they come back as you left them when you return to the LA-3A, as does HF Emphasis.
Comp/Limit carries to and from the LA-2A family. Mix is read through a measured table. Power stands in for the compressor's in/out.
